content.text: {"notes":["The requested joint angles and angular velocities are joint-local quantities in rad and rad/s; angles use the stated unwrapped right-hand convention.","The tip position is requested in the right-handed world frame, whose axes are x-forward, y-left, and z-up, with position reported in metres.","Both joints receive a constant 0.4485119120422087 N·m torque; joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m on the scheduled interval [0.4394, 0.5394) s.","joint_limit_by_T denotes whether either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by the requested time; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
